descriptor: Halloween landing pages, ticket-path readiness, and seasonal creative
status: Ten Halloween landing pages are live and technically ready; completed-order reconciliation remains open
signal: Ten city-specific Halloween landing pages moved from draft to live release and averaged a 92 out of 100 readiness score. Each page is indexable, connected to secure Eventbrite checkout, and tested across desktop and mobile.
goal: Complete indexing and order reconciliation, then activate the seasonal promotion plan against verified ticket-path results.
work: Built and released Halloween landing pages for Atlanta, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Columbia, Greenville, Portland, St. Pete, Macon, Roswell, and Sarasota.
Added city-specific event detail, technical search elements, local copy, internal links, structured event information, and secure ticket paths.
Updated the Event Tracking Sheet with all ten live URLs, focus terms, metadata, source events, and implementation notes.
Prepared the seasonal teaser sequence and completed the current launch-readiness scorecard.
analysis: The August work created a complete ten-city seasonal acquisition surface rather than a planning-only packet. The pages now provide indexable local destinations and a consistent path into Eventbrite checkout.
Checkout initiation tracking is live. Completed-order reconciliation and manual indexing remain the two permission-dependent steps before ticket revenue or return claims are used.
